name: Photon Beam Diffusion
definition: An efficient numerical method for accurately rendering translucent materials that interprets incident light as a continuous beam of photons inside the material and uses Monte Carlo integration to solve the diffusion equation.
summary: Photon Beam Diffusion is a hybrid Monte Carlo method for subsurface scattering that treats light as continuous beams, eliminating quantization and sum-of-Gaussians approximations for greater speed and stability.
